description: A 1inch Fusion quote for a token pair. Use this when a position answers "Strategy is gated": the user/agent does not need an Aqua NFT, because a 1inch resolver with the credential fills the order. Returns the expected output, the Fusion resolver fee and a quote id. Free, read-only, nothing signed or moved. Chain, token addresses and base-unit amounts come from trdefi_positions / trdefi_chains. Note: a Fusion fill is best-effort, not guaranteed: the resolver chooses the venue, and a gated Aqua position is used only if that resolver holds the Aqua NFT.

amount.description: Input amount in token base units, as an integer string.

preset.description: Auction preset. Defaults to the quote recommendation.

wallet.description: The address that will sign the Fusion order.

name: trdefi_fusion_quote
title: Fusion quote (gasless, gated liquidity)
